system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 1 Intermediate, 1 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Call Down the Hunter's Moon, Map the Skies
  • Intermediate (1): Reading of the Natal Stars
  • Advanced (1): Ripples on the Sea of Stars

Base rating-tracker for the Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
